insights.reorder_item: {name}: {on_hand} left, you sell about {forecast} a day. Order {qty} from {supplier}?
insights.reorder_item_no_supplier: {name}: {on_hand} left, you sell about {forecast} a day. Order {qty}?
insights.not_enough_data: I don't have enough sales history yet to suggest an order.
insights.nothing_to_order: Stock looks fine. Nothing to order now.
insights.unknown_product: I couldn't find {name} in your shop.
insights.unavailable: I can't read the shop records right now. Please try again.
jobs.expiry_alert: Expiring soon: {items}. Sell them first or return them to the vendor.
jobs.expired_alert: Expired: {items}. Take them off the shelf.
biz.payment.mismatch: The payment does not match. Please check again.
biz.state.invalid: That step cannot be done now.
biz.invoice.unreadable: I could not read the bill clearly. Please show it again.
biz.invoice.unknown_line: The bill has an item I did not order: {name}.
biz.invoice.price_mismatch: Bill price for {product} is {actual} rupees, agreed price is {expected}.
biz.invoice.line_total_mismatch: The line total for {product} is wrong on the bill.
biz.invoice.total_mismatch: Bill total is {actual} rupees, but the items add up to {expected}.
biz.upi.unsure: I did not hear the payment confirmation clearly.
confirm.expired: That request timed out. Please ask again.
safety.correction: Correction needed: you said {wrong}, which is not in any tool result. Briefly correct yourself using only the numbers from the tool results.
auth.denied: This phone is not linked to this shop.
auth.busy: AIRA is busy with other phones. Please try again in a minute.
live.unavailable: I can't reach the AI right now. Please try again in a minute.
search.unavailable: I couldn't search the web just now. Please ask again in a moment.
error.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
vision.aim.move_back: Move the phone back a little.
vision.aim.spread_out: Spread the items apart so I can count them.
vision.aim.show_items: Show me the items in front of the camera.
vision.aim.show_label: Turn the pack so the label faces the camera.
vision.aim.hold_closer: Hold it closer to the camera.
vision.aim.not_visible: I can't see it right now.
cash.spread_notes: Spread the notes apart so each one is visible.
cash.unsupported_note: I can't count one of these notes. Please check it by hand.
cash.show_again: I'm not sure. Please show the cash again.
loc.stale: {name} was last recorded on {zone}, but it may have moved. I'll check with the camera.
loc.none: I don't have a saved place for {name}. Let me look with the camera.
loc.unclear: Where is {name} kept? Say a place, like fridge 2, top shelf.
guide.start: Hold your hand out and follow the beeps.
guide.lost: I can't see the {name}. Turn slowly to the left.
guide.timeout: I stopped guiding. Ask me again when you are ready.
pick.unsure: Not sure. Hold it closer to the camera.
pick.unsure_label: Not sure. Turn the pack so the label faces the camera.
camera.none: I can't see a camera picture. Please check the camera.
cam.count_unsure: Not sure of the count. Hold the camera still, or step back a little.
cam.obstacle: There is a {label} {side}, {dist}. Go around it slowly.
cam.path_nothing: I see nothing in the way up to a few steps. Walk slowly and check again.
k2.order.fallback: The order message is ready. Double-tap Send, then tell me when it is sent.
k2.order.no_telegram: {supplier} is not on the AIRA Telegram bot yet.
k2.order.mark_sent_q: Did you send the order to {supplier}?
k2.order.telegram_down: The Telegram bot could not send it right now.
k2.order.sent_demo: Order sent to the demo {supplier}. The reply comes in a few seconds.
k2.order.qty_unclear: I can't order that amount of {product}. Say how many packs.
k2.delivery.started: Delivery from {supplier}. Show each pack to the camera, one at a time.
k2.delivery.none: No delivery is open. Say: start the delivery.
k2.delivery.readback_short: I counted {counted} packs of {product}. The order was {expected}. {missing} may be missing. Save {counted}, or shall I count again?
k2.delivery.readback_over: I counted {counted} packs of {product}. The order was {expected}. That is {extra} extra. Save {counted}, or shall I count again?
k2.invoice.should_be: The bill total is {total} rupees. It should be {payable} rupees.
k2.delivery.nothing_seen: I did not see any {product}. Show each pack to the camera.
k2.pay.plan: Pay {amount} rupees: {notes}. Show the notes to the camera.
k2.pay.cash_q: {amount} rupees counted. Give it to {supplier} and confirm?
k2.pay.cash_wrong: I see {seen} rupees, but it should be {amount}.
k2.pay.upi_q: Pay {amount} rupees to {supplier} from your UPI app, then say yes.
k2.pay.not_ready: Check the delivery and the bill before paying.
k2.cash.unclear: I cannot see the notes clearly. Show them again.
k2.sale.running: {items}, total {total} rupees so far. Cash or UPI?
k2.sale.upi_over_q: {paid} rupees received by UPI, {extra} extra. Return {extra} and complete the sale?
k2.sale.upi_short_q: Only {paid} of {total} rupees received by UPI, {short} short. Complete the sale anyway?
k2.sale.change: Received {tendered}. Give back {change} rupees: {notes}. Show the change to the camera.
k2.sale.change_wrong: That change is {seen} rupees. It should be {change}.
k2.sale.upi_heard_q: {amount} rupees received by UPI. Complete the sale?
k2.sale.upi_wrong: The soundbox said {heard} rupees, but the bill is {total}.
k2.sale.upi_timeout_q: I did not hear the soundbox. Did you receive {total} rupees by UPI?
k2.sale.stock_changed: The stock changed. Check the items again.
camera.delivery: Camera {camera}: a delivery seems to have come. I see about {n} packs. Shall I count them?
camera.low_stock: Camera {camera}: only about {left} {product} left on the shelf.
camera.customer: Camera {camera}: someone is waiting at the counter.
camera.motion: Camera {camera}: movement in the shop after hours.
k3.product.exists_q: {product} is already in the shop. Add stock, or a new product?
k3.product.price_q: What is the selling price of {product}, in rupees?
k3.product.unit_q: Is {product} sold by the litre, pack, jar or box?
k3.product.duplicate: {product} is already in the shop. Say a different name or size.
k3.change.name: name {name}
k3.stock.unknown_q: I don't know {product}. Add it as a new product?
k3.supplier.channel_q: How do you reach {supplier}: Telegram, WhatsApp or a call?
k3.supplier.no_link: The Telegram secret is not set, so I can't make the vendor link yet.
check.micSay: Checking the microphone. Say: Hello AIRA.
check.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site, then try again.
check.micMissing: No microphone found. Connect one, then try again.
check.micSilent: I heard nothing. Check the microphone is not muted, then try again.
check.camLookLaptop: Checking the camera. Look at the laptop camera.
check.camLookPhone: Checking the camera. Point the phone at what is in front of you.
check.camDark: The picture is too dark. Turn on a light, then try again.
check.camBlurry: The picture is blurred. Hold still and wipe the lens, then try again.
check.camCovered: Something is covering the camera. Uncover the lens, then try again.
check.camBlank: The camera shows nothing. Close other apps using the camera, then try again.
check.camUnclear: I could not make out anything. Point the camera at something, then try again.
check.camBlocked: The camera is blocked. Allow the camera for this site, then try again.
check.camOffline: I could not reach AIRA to check the camera. Check the internet, then try again.
check.camBusy: Too many checks. Wait a minute, then try again.
check.camUnavailable: AIRA's camera check is not answering. Try again in a moment.
check.allGood: Microphone and camera work. Tap anywhere to start talking.
describe.on: Describe mode on. I will tell you what comes into view as you move.
describe.timeout: Describe mode stopped after ten minutes. Say describe as I walk to start again.
describe.cap: Describe mode paused to save the camera budget. Say describe as I walk to start again.
find.free_none: I can't find it. Show me the shelf.
cam.list.none: I can't see any products. Show me the shelf.
mem.last_seen: I last saw your {item} {place}, {when}. Check there first.
mem.last_seen_old: I last saw your {item} {place}, {when}. That was a while ago, it may have moved. Check there first.
mem.none: I have not seen your {item} yet. Show me around and I will remember.
mem.off: I am not remembering new things right now. Say start remembering to turn it on.
mem.forgot_all: Done. I forgot everything I saw.
mem.forgot_item: Done. I forgot where your {item} was.
mem.remember_on: Okay. I will remember where I see your things.
mem.remember_off: Okay. I stopped remembering. Nothing new will be saved.
mem.watch_item: Okay. I will remember where I see your {item}.
k3.price.unset: {product} has no price yet. Say the price to set it.
k3.price.none: No prices yet. Add a product first.
ambient.on: Okay. I will tell you what you show me and what comes into view.
ambient.off: Quiet mode. I will speak only when you ask.
walk.start: Okay. Walk slowly. I will guide you to the {name}.
walk.which: Where do you want to go?
walk.arrived: Stop. The {name} is right in front of you. Reach forward.
walk.obstacle_left: Stop. {label} in front. Move a little left.
walk.obstacle_right: Stop. {label} in front. Move a little right.
walk.left: {name} on your left. Turn left a little.
walk.right: {name} on your right. Turn right a little.
walk.not_found: I can't find the {name}. Try turning around slowly.
walk.blind: I can't see well. Please stop and wait.
walk.timeout: I stopped guiding. Ask me again when you are ready.
